fresh_leads.qualification_text: Software Engineering - Web/Javascript (Northeastern Co-op) New York Opportunities for January 2027 Priceline is currently recruiting for co-op positions in the following roles on our NYC teams: Software Engineering - Web/Javascript Software Engineering - Full Stack Our Team Join an agile team of smart and talented professionals dedicated to building the next generation of travel applications. Our Technology team, composed of a number of sub-teams and approximately half of the people at Priceline, plays a central and critical role in the company: building and maintaining applications that serve millions of customers, and enabling the business to grow and evolve. At Priceline, our Technology, Product, and Business team members work closely together to define and achieve our goals, creating an engaging and collaborative work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and the team priorities are well balanced and aligned with company goals. Our Technology The technology at Priceline needs to serve our customers and support our business, holding up to the scale & growth of our business (hundreds of millions of searches a day), while allowing for fast and safe innovation. The quality of our work is very important to us. For example, we believe in software craftsmanship and that there is real value in developing software that can be easily understood, maintained, and extended. We are very proud of the software and systems we have built, and we always have ambitious and exciting plans for what's next. We employ new technologies when and where we think they will benefit our efforts, and we leverage third-party tools and frameworks when we think doing so is a better strategy than building our own. Our technology landscape is always changing and evolving, and we have a constant cadence of improving existing applications, building new applications, and deprecating old applications. Currently, our technology stack includes the following: JavaScript and frameworks, including Node.js, React/Redux, and GraphQL Java, Go, Kotlin and frameworks, including those from Spring. iOS and Android languages and tools Cloud deployments, tools, and capabilities from providers like GCP and AWS. Various database, streaming, and search technologies, including Cassandra, Kafka, Spark, and Solr. Third-party tools, including GitHub, Splunk, Fastly, Perimeterx, New Relic, PagerDuty, Slack, Jira/Confluence, and Zoom. Our Culture Considering the large size of our business and the number of customers we have, Priceline has a relatively small team, including just a few hundred technologists. This allows us to have a culture with both the agility and energy of a startup and the stability and resources of a Fortune 500 company. It also means that we need to work smartly and effectively. Although we do work hard at Priceline, we strongly value a healthy work/life balance. We enjoy what we do, enjoy the camaraderie of the wonderful people at Priceline, continuously learn and grow, and appreciate the impact we each can have on the business. If you were to walk through one of our offices or join one of our Zoom meetings, you would see that we dress casually, engage in spirited discussions regarding our work, and embrace an open environment where everyone is approachable. Priceline is also a mindful, respectful, and ethical company. We have clearly articulated our mission, purpose, and values, and they are a big part of our culture: Our Mission : To be the best travel deal makers in the world. Our Purpose : Help everyone experience the moments that matter. Our Values: Customer: We put the customer at the center of everything we do. Trust: We have the highest ethical standards supported by honesty and fairness. Team: We embrace diverse teams that work together to exceed our goals Accountability: We take ownership of our individual and team commitments. Innovation: We drive innovation through focused learning and experimentation. What you will do You'll be working as part of a tight-knit team, supporting our high-traffic Hotel, Airline, Rental Car, and Vacation Package businesses, building applications that deliver real value to our customers. You will be working on important projects and initiatives, supported by your team as you get up to speed. You will be working closely with Technology, Product, and Business team members who will be happy to welcome you to Priceline and will always be interested to hear your opinions and ideas regarding our work. You will learn a lot, and may end up smiling and laughing a lot, too. Relevant Skills Below are the skills we look for when hiring in each technical discipline. We do not expect co-op students to have experience in all of these areas, but any experience you do have in these areas are a plus! Relevant Skills for All Roles A collaborative work ethic and the ability to work within a self-organized, cross-functional team. Strong analysis & problem-solving skills. Positive attitude & willingness to quickly learn on the job Great communication skills. Familiarity with agile and Scrum. Experience running applications in the Cloud. Knowledge of Git and Gitflow. Continuous integration and automated testing e-commerce experience a plus. Experience with open source projects a plus. Relevant Skills for Software Engineering - Web/Javascript Proficiency with JavaScript core language features and functionality, including ES6 and ES7 features. Experience with a modern client-side JavaScript framework or library (e.g. React, Angular, Ember) Understanding of Node.js and how it works. Experience with common libraries like Express.js and using Node as a web server or micro-service. Working with and building RESTful API's and GraphQL. Software development patterns like OOP, Flux/Redux, Modular, MVVM , MVC and Observer. Understanding of practical uses of responsive design and HTML, the use of tools like Sass and the authoring modular CSS (CSS modules or PostCSS). Experience with NoSQL databases and SQL composition skills are a plus. Familiar with web server-side technologies, such as GoLang, JSP , Ruby or Python are a plus. Additional Information Priceline is not currently offering visa sponsorship or transfers. Priceline has a hybrid office policy and employees need to work from their assigned office(s) twice per week, preferably on Tuesday, Wednesday, and/or Thursday. The same will apply to co-op students. Students must live in commutable distance to our NYC offices, depending on the position, during the co-op session. Priceline does not offer housing. NU has housing in Manhattan, close to our NYC office. Our NYC office is located at: Empire State Building, 20 W. 34th St., New York, NY 10001 Who We Are WE ARE PRICELINE. Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it's a dream vacation, your cousin's graduation, or your best friend's wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. Our culture is unique and inspiring (that's what our employees tell us). We're a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn't stabilized. We're on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable. If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out! Flexible work at Priceline Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. Inclusion is a Big Deal! To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. Applying for this position We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees , please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply. External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

You'll also get exposure to risk-factor modeling and exposure analytics, and direct portfolio-manager support — strategy diagnostics, scenario analysis, and allocation questions. WE'RE LOOKING FOR: · New grad through experienced hires. · Strong software engineering: Python plus at least one systems language, good design instincts, and the ability to build tooling other people depend on. · Solid grounding in quantitative finance — you understand what a Sharpe ratio, a risk factor, a backtest, or a portfolio optimizer actually means and why it's built the way it is, not just how to implement it. fresh_leads.qualification_text: Summer Associate Internship (Data Scientist) Vienna, VA, United States; Pensacola, FL, United States Summer Associates Summer Associate Full time Some College Digital Payments is part of the Savings & Membership Department. Our vision is to provide personalized, scalable, and secure money movement experiences that exceed members' evolving payment expectations. We are seeking a motivated, analytical Summer Associate to join the Digital Payments Analytics team. In this role, you will use data science and business intelligence techniques to solve real business problems across non-card money movement products such as ACH, Zelle, Real-Time Payments (RTP), FedNow, member-to-member transfers, wires, Bill Pay, and cross-border payments. You will partner with analysts and business stakeholders to turn complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and decision-support tools. The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later. What you May Work On Analyze member adoption, engagement, transaction flows, and movement of funds across non-card payment products and channels. Examine the member payment journey, including when members first adopt a payment product and how their usage changes over time. Evaluate how members use payment products together and identify shifts in behavior across established and emerging payment options. Develop analytical models that help identify opportunities to improve product adoption and member experiences. Build dashboards and visualizations that make payment performance and emerging trends easier to understand. Apply statistical methods to large datasets to support product strategy and business decisions. Assess how payment behavior affects member experience, operational efficiency, product economics, and risk. Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations for business stakeholders and leadership. Responsibilities Collaborate with cross-functional partners to understand business questions and define analytical approaches. Clean, prepare, and explore large member and transaction datasets. Write efficient code in Python and SQL and use platforms such as Databricks to analyze large datasets and support repeatable analytics. Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI tools to support research, coding, analysis, documentation, and the development of business insights, with appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs. Develop dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Microsoft Power BI or Tableau. Apply statistical, predictive, or prescriptive methods to identify patterns and opportunities. Document methods, assumptions, and findings clearly. Present insights and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences. Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a closely related field. Experience using Python, R, and/or SQL for data preparation and analysis. Experience with exploratory data analysis and working with large or complex datasets. Familiarity with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Microsoft Power BI or Tableau. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to connect analytical findings to business questions and explain results clearly.
